entries.search: Antarctic model finds ice-loss risk persists under strong emissions cuts An Antarctic ice-sheet model calibrated against satellite observations estimated at least a 0.92 probability of net mass loss this century, even with strong emissions cuts. entries.search: Westlothiana’s hidden gills overturn its reptile ancestry X-ray scans of Westlothiana lizziae, a Scottish fossil dating back 345 million years, revealed internal gills and a fish-like mouth.
